title: The Well Heard EVERY Word 🪣
premise: Our town's wishing well grants every wish word for word. Three years ago I wished I'd never lose my big brother Wes, and now he cannot get one block away from me, even as he lands his dream job across the country.
twist: You only lose what you don't mean to let go of: I let Wes go on purpose, the leash lets him pass the town line, and he reveals he heard my wish three years ago and stayed so I wouldn't feel bad.
world: A sunny brick town square with a round pale stone well, a hilly street of painted houses with a brick-red corner house, a green town-line post and a rule meter tag that fills toward a red notch.
